column3: Close to the Hebrew; “joy” is rendered “gladness.”
NASB follows the written Hebrew text (Kethiv) with “and not we ourselves”; the reading tradition (Qere), reflected in the gloss, has “and we are his.” “Flock” is rendered “sheep.”
Close to the Hebrew; “go [into]” is rendered “Enter.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for ever” is rendered “everlasting,” and “a generation and a generation” as “all generations.”
